title: 2009 HMMT February Algebra Problem 2
statement: Let \(S\) be the sum of all the real coefficients of the expansion of \((1+i x)^{2009}\). What is \(\log _{2}(S)\) ?

solutions.text: The sum of all the coefficients is \((1+i)^{2009}\), and the sum of the real coefficients is the real part of this, which is \(\frac{1}{2}\left((1+i)^{2009}+(1-i)^{2009}\right)=2^{1004}\). Thus \(\log _{2}(S)=1004\).
